scope: Picture-reading test, 2026-10-22: the 308 prepared requests of picture_test.py (test set picture-test-20261021) sent to seven Gemma 4 models in turn on one NVIDIA RTX A6000, Slurm job 24756981 on MedicineBow. No solver run.

picture-test-24756981.tar.gz.what: the archive the job wrote: every reply and record of the run

pythonfoam-picture-test-20261021.tar.gz.what: the input bundle: git archive of 58e00d9, the 308 requests, the answer key, the published 2026-10-17/20 answers

notes: Sources are paths inside the two archives named in 'archives'. On the cluster the job folder was /cluster/medbow/gscratch/syome/github_repos/picture-test-20261021/pythonfoam-picture-test-20261021/results/picture-test-24756981.
Every script in runtime/sha256.txt equals commit 58e00d9 except hpc/picture_test.slurm (de18f174...), whose module and PATH lines were edited on the cluster; that file is not in the results.
The job ran on an RTX A6000; the instructions named the A30 partition. Which partition was used is not in the records.

Per-request raw replies, parsed replies, client records and metrics are in the job archive; only the client records (result.json) of the October 17 replies are here. Sent request bodies were not kept; metrics.jsonl gives the hashes of the sent and the prepared body.

The job archive holds a second copy of each server log, command, model list and GPU line named by model; those logs are prefixes of the runtime/server copies (73 or 74 bytes shorter), the other files identical. Only the runtime/server copies are here.
Files named *.log at the source are stored as .txt because .gitignore excludes *.log; bytes unchanged.
pictures/ holds PNG bytes decoded from the base64 image_url of the named request body.

independent-rescore.py re-scores from metrics.jsonl, the October 17 result.json files and test-set/truth.private.json without picture_test.py; independent-rescore.json is its output (518 report cells and lines checked, 0 differ).
Projector types were read afterwards from the GGUF headers of the pinned files on Hugging Face: Q8_0 for e2b, BF16 for the others; the job did not record them.
truth.private.json means withheld from model input, not private personal information.
Original records contain cluster paths and server PIDs as provenance.
